frames.reach: position_m: report frame, Z up, metres; the body faces -Y and its right side is -X at frame 0 (utils/motiogen/task_geometry.py); origin: the method's initial pelvis joint projected on the floor. target_body_m: [forward, right, up] in the same frame. The nominal Rajagopal body stands for the pelvis joint with its hip-centre midpoint (convention, not derived; its pelvis origin is 5.6 cm ahead of that midpoint); in HumanML3D standing frames the pelvis joint is 1.2 cm ahead of the hip midpoint, so a method receives each target 1.2 cm further forward relative to its hips than the nominal check assumed (sensitivity: reachability_origin_shift_+0.012.json)
frames.reach_nominal_body: risk-zone targets from the nominal Rajagopal body (task_reachability.py): front = shoulder + 0.8 arm forward at the shoulder lateral offset, side90 = shoulder + 0.8 arm outward; heights above the floor
frames.root_goal: goal_start / goal_next: native goal coordinates of the method, metres, same frame as the native matrix (cardinal directions 0, 90, 180, 270 deg; added diagonals 45, 135, 225, 315 deg)
frames.ardy: direction_xz: native XZ unit vector (forward +Z, body right -X), utils/motiogen/task_geometry.native_direction

overhead_height.rule: min over the flat limits (rajagopal and humanml, front and side90, both hands) - 0.05 m (convention, not derived), floored to mm

split.dimensions: target position, paraphrase, seed (design section 14 item 1)
split.rule: a row is held out if any of its dimensions is held out, except that a row whose input is identical to an already-run input (method, task input, seed, condition) is always development
split.identical_input_sources: native matrix rows (paused clock); V2 CHOIS runs with condition exactly guidance 0; M0 / M0a ARDY runs whose extra condition keys are all at the ardy_native.py defaults (waypoints sparse, target_mode path; the M0a key text only labels the prompt, which is compared itself) and whose path switch_seconds is the default 5 s; successful runs only
split.held_out_positions: per method: 4 of the 12 added tasks, interleaved so that both sets cover every zone / direction / distance / speed / family level (methods.<m>.held_out_positions); ARDY and CHOIS have none (methods.<m>.no_held_out_position)
split.paraphrase_rotation: nested Latin square (user 2026-11-09): within each hand the 12 tasks are indexed i = 0..11 (native matrix tasks first, then the risk-zone tasks); seed s in 20-23 uses paraphrase (i + s - 20) mod 4, seed 24 uses paraphrase 4; the same paraphrase index applies to the neutral and the consistent text
